description: This file defines a Perl class 'Coocook::Model::Badge' that generates SVG images of badges, inspired by img.shields.io. It contains a method 'create_badge' which constructs an SVG badge with customizable text and colors.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Badge
classes.description: A class responsible for generating SVG badge images with customizable text and colors.

methods.name: create_badge
methods.description: Creates an SVG badge with specified left and right text content and an optional color for the right segment.
